01514 Gacham {ga'-kham}

字根已不使用, 意為"燒"; 陽性專有名詞 人名

欽定本 - Gaham 1; 1

迦含 = "燃燒"
1) 亞伯拉罕的兄弟拿鶴與他的妾流瑪所生的兒子 (#創 22:24|)

01514 Gacham {gah'-kham}

from an unused root meaning to burn;; n pr m

AV - Gaham 1; 1

Gaham = "burning"
1) a son of Abraham's brother Nahor and his concubine Reumah
